description: Rust-backed temporal ROI preprocessor using back-propagated detections to maintain and predict regions of interest over time.

padding_factor.description: Fractional padding around each ROI when cropping.

max_missed_updates.description: Number of consecutive updates without a match before a track is removed.

velocity_smoothing.description: Exponential smoothing factor for velocity updates.

match_distance_px.description: Maximum center distance in pixels to associate detections to existing tracks.

max_tracks.description: Maximum number of simultaneous tracks to maintain.
